title: Item:Housewarming Invitation
wikitext:
[[File:Itemdesc Housewarming Invitation.png|right]] Talk to [[Durk the Deranged]] in [[the Twelve]] to receive this invitation. Open your [[Inventory]] and double-click it to enter the quest [[Palace of Stone]]. * Destroyed upon ''entering'' the quest - if you leave, you will have to get another from Durk in [[The Twelve]]. * Destroyed on logging out. * Destroyed on death. * {{Bind|BtC|BoA|1}} ''In accordance with the wishes of LORD [[Orlassk|ORLASSK]],

You are cordially invited to celebrate the completion of the [[Palace of Stone]], the new residence of the Lord of Stone within [[Khyber (lore)|Khyber]].

The housewarming reception shall commence promptly without delay. Please do not RSVP, as your attendance is mandatory. You will be pulled into Khyber upon reading this invitation. [[Category:Quest items]]
